title: You Don't Need a Million Dollars to Retire
author: Duane
panel_brief: A first-person retirement memoir-guide by 'Duane', who retired at 59 in 2021 on $548,000 (no pension) and publishes his real balance monthly on YouTube. Audience: 55+ with $250K-$750K. Promise: 'you don't need a million dollars to retire' — real numbers, a boring repeatable method. 10 chapters in 3 parts.
